events.title: World Car-Free Day
events.note: An international day promoting sustainable urban mobility and reducing car usage.
events.marketing_angle: Join the movement for a cleaner, greener city!
events.why_selected: Raises awareness about sustainable transportation options.

events.title: Czech Statehood Day
events.note: A national holiday commemorating the establishment of the Czechoslovak state in 1918.
events.marketing_angle: Celebrate Czech Statehood Day with pride and joy!
events.why_selected: A significant national holiday celebrating Czech history and identity.

events.title: Formula 1: Singapore Grand Prix
events.note: The Singapore Grand Prix, a night race on the streets of Marina Bay, is a highlight of the F1 calendar.
events.marketing_angle: Experience the thrill of night racing in Singapore!
events.why_selected: A prestigious Formula 1 race known for its unique night-time setting.

events.title: Start of the New Hockey Season: Czech Republic vs Sweden
events.note: The Czech national ice hockey team opens the season against Sweden in the Euro Hockey Tour at the O2 Arena in Prague.
events.marketing_angle: Witness the Czech team kick off the new season with a thrilling match!
events.why_selected: An exciting start to the ice hockey season with the national team.

events.title: UEFA Nations League: Czech Republic vs Croatia
events.note: The Czech national football team faces Croatia in a crucial UEFA Nations League match at Eden Arena in Prague.
events.marketing_angle: Support the Czech team in this pivotal match!
events.why_selected: A high-stakes international football match featuring the Czech national team.
